purpose: Certify the coexistence model for Framework v1 (authoritative) and Framework v2 (advisory) during Hybrid Mode. Define authority boundaries, rollback paths, escalation paths, and shadow-mode interaction rules.

hybrid_mode_definition.v1_role: Authoritative — all certification decisions, content modifications, and learner delivery pool are governed by v1 processes
hybrid_mode_definition.v2_role: Advisory — Framework v2 pipeline runs alongside v1, producing scan artifacts, readiness classifications, delta reviews, and recommendations without modifying content or certification state
hybrid_mode_definition.coexistence: Both frameworks operate on the same pack files. v2 reads files (scan artifacts). v1 writes files (certification actions, content modifications). No conflict — v2 is strictly read-only.
hybrid_mode_definition.trigger_for_shadow_mode: S208 — after 3 successful certification waves under v2 advisement (S206, S207, S208 pre-shadow), v2 becomes authoritative and v1 becomes verification-only.

v1_exclusive_authority: Modifying CorrectChoice or any answer-key field
Modifying Stem, Choices, ExplanationCorrect, ExplanationWrong fields
Deploying items to the learner delivery pool
Executing backup protocol writes to pack files
Updating DEFECT_LIBRARY.md with new defect entries
authority_boundaries.shared_authority_none: No operation has split authority. v1 is always authoritative for content and certification. v2 is always authoritative for scan, readiness, delta, and recommendation artifacts. The scan artifact references v1 content — it does not modify it.

v2_to_v1_rollback.trigger: Framework v2 scan orchestrator produces inconsistent results (e.g., non-deterministic delta hashes, readiness classification drift between runs)
procedure: Compare conflicting scan artifacts using delta_ledger.js (S322 Script 2) to isolate the non-deterministic component.
Fix S322 infrastructure script causing non-determinism.
Re-run scan orchestrator — verify deterministic output.
Re-authorize v2 operations via Governance Board.
During halt: v1 continues authoritative operation. No certification waves are impacted.
v2_to_v1_rollback.rollback_duration: ~1 hour (typically a script fix, not an architecture change)
v2_to_v1_rollback.pack_file_impact: ZERO — v2 is read-only. No pack file rollback needed.

v1_content_rollback.trigger: Certification action produces an incorrect question_state or content change
procedure: Re-run v2 scan orchestrator: Gate -1 through Gate 4 on the restored file.
Compare scan artifact against pre-action artifact: verify the rollback restored correct state.
v1_content_rollback.v2_assistance: v2 scan artifact provides immediate before/after comparison — the delta review engine identifies exactly which items changed between the action and the rollback.

hash_mismatch.trigger: Pack file SHA-256 does not match delta_ledger.json baseline at session T0
hash_mismatch.response: Halt all agents. Spawn governance agent. Execute G1-G5 reconciliation runbook (Session 31). Attribute drift → isolate source → classify as authorized-change or corruption → adopt-or-quarantine.

scan_artifact_corruption.trigger: Scan artifact fails S202.1 validation (10 rules) — missing section, invalid field type, schema mismatch
scan_artifact_corruption.response: Re-generate artifact via scan_orchestrator.js --force. If regeneration also fails, escalate to infrastructure audit (Board E).

readiness_disagreement.trigger: Readiness classification from v2 disagrees with v1 human reviewer's assessment
readiness_disagreement.response: v1 reviewer documents the disagreement. v2 classification is advisory — v1 may proceed with certification. The disagreement is logged to readiness_disagreement_log.json. After 5+ disagreements on the same defect class, the readiness classification rules are reviewed.

recommendation_conflict.trigger: v2 recommendation (REC-ID) suggests a remediation action that v1 reviewer disagrees with
recommendation_conflict.response: v1 reviewer closes the recommendation with status REJECTED and reason. The recommendation registry tracks closure evidence. After 10+ rejections on the same recommendation type, the recommendation template is reviewed.

shadow_mode_interactions.scan_artifact_consumption: During Hybrid Mode, v2 scan artifacts are produced but not enforced. Governance Rules 6-8 are ACTIVE in v2 but advisory — v1 certification boards may review v2 readiness classifications but are not bound by them.
shadow_mode_interactions.delta_review_advisement: v2 delta review produces inheritance recommendations (IR-001 through IR-005). v1 certification boards may adopt or ignore these recommendations. Adoption rate is tracked as a v2 effectiveness metric.
shadow_mode_interactions.recommendation_pipeline: v2 produces REC-ID recommendations. v1 determines whether to execute, defer, or reject them. All REC-ID lifecycle transitions (OPEN→IN_PROGRESS→CLOSED/REJECTED) are tracked in RECOMMENDATION_REGISTRY.json.
shadow_mode_interactions.reporting: v2 produces 4 reports (Registry, Quality, Governance, Throughput). v1 produces ad-hoc reports as needed. After Hybrid Mode, v1 ad-hoc reports are retired per S203 migration plan.

certification_verdict.verdict: CERTIFIED — Hybrid Mode operations model is complete and conflict-free
conditions: PRE-205-01 (DL-034 P1-E-R33 archive) must be completed before 800-Series full-pack Gate -1 pass
S206 must execute as the first session under active Rules 6-8 governance
v2 readiness classifications remain advisory until S208 (Shadow Mode transition)
certification_verdict.confidence: HIGH — all 4 pilot sessions (S204, S322, S202.1, S205) confirmed v1+v2 coexistence without conflict
